title: Move prod to hybrid fetch1 after the 48 quality gate (220k/auto/mr1 validation)

cases.detail: +15.2% @16k and +14.5% @64k vs the adopted offload config (>=5%)
217853-token prefill + sustained decode, no OOM, VRAM 23.8 GiB

rollback_recipe: sudo cp /opt/FreeToken/.x299-backup/mtp-test.conf.before-49 /etc/systemd/system/freetoken.service.d/mtp-test.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart freetoken.service (restores offload@auto/mr1).
